250 days from 1131-11-12.  
1131 is not a leap year.  
Days remaining in 1131 after Nov 12:  
Nov: 30-12 = 18 days left.  
Dec: 31 days. Total = 49 days.  
250 - 49 = 201 days into 1132.  
1132 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not by 100).  
Jan 31, Feb 29, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30 = 31+29+31+30+31+30 = 182 days.  
201 - 182 = 19 days into July.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 1132-07-19
